title: Lease Ledger Fee Rule
content:
This rule sets out every fee that may be posted to the Apartment Home Lease ledger. No other fee may be posted to the lease ledger; utility, parking, storage and pet charges belong to their own charters.

## 1. When fees may post

Lease fees post only while the lease is applied, approved, active, in default or eviction filed. The status is read from the lease record.

## 2. The fees

**2.1 Application and administration.** The application fee posts at submission, and the administration fee posts once when the lease is approved.

**2.2 Recurring community fees.** The monthly amenity fee, trash valet fee and smart home fee post on the floor plan's rent due day of every month in possession, at the floor plan's amounts. A fee whose floor plan amount is 0.00 is included in rent and posts no line. In the move-in month each recurring fee is prorated exactly as rent is — the same days billed and days in period, rounded half up to the cent.

**2.3 Liability program fee.** The liability program fee, at the floor plan's community liability program charge, posts on the rent due day for every month in which no proof of insurance is on file on that day. It is never prorated; it stops from the first due day on which proof is on file; and accepting proof never refunds a month already posted. Proof qualifies only when its personal liability limit is at least the floor plan's minimum personal liability limit and the policy names Larkspur Residential Trust as interested party.

**2.4 Access fobs.** Each lost, damaged or additional access fob beyond the fobs issued at move-in is billed at the floor plan's fob charge, as one line for all fobs issued the same day.

**2.5 Lockouts.** A lockout answered 8:00-18:00 local time Monday-Saturday is billed at the floor plan's business-hours lockout charge, and any other lockout at the after-hours charge; the line records which service window applied. While the number of lockout lines already dated within the trailing 365 days before this lockout is below the floor plan's free lockout allowance, the lockout posts a 0.00 lockout line instead. The trailing 365 days end on and include the evaluation date, and the count includes 0.00 lockout lines.

**2.6 Lease modification.** Adding or removing a leaseholder or occupant mid-term posts the lease modification fee once per signed modification.

**2.7 Court cost.** A court cost line posts on the date a file is referred to eviction counsel, in the amount fixed for the community's state:

| State of the community | Court cost |
|---|---|
| California (CA) | $385.00 |
| Washington (WA) | $157.00 |
| Colorado (CO) | $106.00 |
| Texas (TX) | $129.00 |
| Georgia (GA) | $98.00 |
| Arizona (AZ) | $83.00 |

## 3. Applying the rule — hypothetical cases

- **Lockout allowance.** On a floor plan allowing 2 free lockouts, a resident with 0.00 lockout lines on 3 March and 20 August of one year, locked out again on 1 December of the same year, already has 2 lockout lines in the trailing 365 days; the new lockout is billed at the business-hours or after-hours figure according to when it was answered. Had only one earlier lockout fallen in the window, the new one would post as a 0.00 line.
- **Fobs.** Two replacement fobs issued on the same day are one line for both, at twice the per-fob charge.
- **Insurance proof accepted mid-month.** Proof accepted on the 12th stops the liability program fee from the next due day; the fee posted on the 1st of that month stays.
- **Proof that does not qualify.** A policy with a sufficient liability limit that does not name Larkspur Residential Trust as interested party does not qualify, and the liability program fee continues.

Dates and counts in these cases are example inputs.
